info.name: Scan2Ship API Collection
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Scan2Ship logistics platform.

Generated from source on 2026-08-08 — covers all 133 handlers across 87 route files.

## Setup
1. Set `base_url` (default `http://localhost:3000/api`).
2. Run **Authentication → Create Auth / Login**; the test script stores `auth_token` and `client_id` automatically.
3. For External API requests, set `api_key`.

## Notes
- Each request description states its required auth and minimum role, and links to its source file.
- Query parameters are added disabled by default — enable the ones you need.
- Request bodies show required fields with sample values; optional fields are omitted.
- Endpoints marked ⚠️ have no authentication. Several are unintended; see `docs/audits/FULL_APP_AUDIT_2026-08-08.md`.
